name: When should I call a plumber for suspected tree roots in my sewer line?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a plumber for suspected tree roots in my sewer line?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a plumber as soon as you notice persistent signs like slow drains, recurrent clogs, or gurgling noises from your plumbing fixtures. Addressing the issue early can prevent major sewage backups, expensive pipe damage, and emergency repairs. Early intervention can save you significant time and money in the long run.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a plumber immediately if you notice slow drains, recurrent clogs, or gurgling, to prevent major damage and costly repairs.
